title: Tesla sustains its EV sales momentum despite US troubles
slides: Can Tesla keep winning while America turns away?
US sales fell as competition and politics bite
But global deliveries hit new records anyway
Your next car may come from Shanghai, not Texas
Check where your EV is actually built
thread_text:
1. Tesla's US sales are falling

But global deliveries just hit a record. The reason? Most of those cars weren't built in America.

2. Politics is hurting demand

US sales dropped as competition and political backlash bite. Meanwhile, factories in Shanghai are shipping more cars than ever.

3. Your next EV might be Chinese

The car you buy could come from Shanghai, not Texas. That changes everything about the 'American' brand.

4. Check where your car is made

Most people don't know their EV's real origin. Look at the VIN or the window sticker. You might be surprised.

5. Look up your EV's factory

Go to your car's VIN or manufacturer site. Find out which country built it. Does that change your view?

instagram.caption:
Most Tesla buyers in the US don't know their car was built in Shanghai, not Texas. 🚗

US sales dropped as competition and politics bit into demand.

But global deliveries still hit a record — thanks to factories abroad.

That reshapes what "American brand" even means now.

If you make content about cars, tech or trade, check where your EV is actually built before you call it American. 🔍

Look at the VIN or the window sticker.

Would knowing your Tesla came from China change how you feel about driving it? 🤔
